subject: Invoice recipient change, withholding tax responsibility & pricing schedule clarification
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@auroraai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:08:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice recipient change + withholding tax question

Hi Karthik,

Quick one from procurement as we pull the PO together for the order form: can we have the invoices routed to our Italy entity (Aurora S.r.l.) and include PO #6678 on all invoices? I've attached the PO draft.

Second, our tax team asked whether Redwood will gross-up invoices if Italian withholding is applied, or whether Aurora should withhold and provide the appropriate certificate of tax withheld. Our internal policy requires Net60 payment terms — is that acceptable?

Also please confirm currency: we prefer EUR.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Director, Finance Operations
Aurora AI
attachments: PO_6678.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@auroraai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice recipient change + withholding tax question

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for the PO. Looping in our finance and legal lead (Kimberly) and your account lead Ben to move this along.

Short answers up front: we can route invoices to Aurora S.r.l. and we can invoice in EUR. Withholding is something we need to confirm with finance/legal — Redwood's default is not to gross-up unless there is a negotiated price uplift, but we have two operational paths we can offer (see below). Regarding Net60, our commercial team typically offers Net45 on new order forms, but Ben and I can escalate if Aurora requires Net60 due to internal policy. If Net60 is a must, we can accept it provided the invoice flow and PO acceptance meet the schedule (outlined below).

A couple of asks so we can finalize redlines quickly:
- Can you send the tax residency / withholding certificate for the Aurora Italy entity (Italy withholding evidence) so our tax team can assess liability?
- Confirm the minimum commit cadence: is the commitment annual or quarterly for this PO? That affects proration and invoice sequencing.
- Do you need a gross-up clause in the SOW/order form, or would Aurora prefer to retain withholding and provide the withhold evidence?

Proposed next steps: Kimberly will circulate a short redline to capture the two options for handling withholding (gross-up with capped uplift OR Aurora withholds and provides evidence). We'll also add a simple FX protection clause for material currency swings and list invoice recipient/address fields. Ben will follow up on minimum commit cadence and any billing-related exceptions.

I expect we can have a redline back to you by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marco Bianchi <mbianchi@auroraai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@auroraai.com, Elena Rossi <elena@auroraai.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 12:41:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice recipient change + withholding tax question

Karthik — thanks. A few clarifications from procurement:

- Net60 is a hard requirement for Aurora's vendor payment cycle. We cannot move to Net45.
- PO #6678 is for an annual commitment (covers the first 12 months).
- We'll provide the tax certificate now (attached) but we need Redwood's position on whether you will gross-up. If Redwood chooses to gross-up, please state the uplift percentage in the order form. If Redwood asks Aurora to withhold, we'll need Redwood to accept that withholding and agree to accept the net payment after tax with Aurora providing withholding receipts.

Also, for invoicing: the invoice should include: Aurora S.r.l. legal address (Via Dante 12, Milan, IT), VAT ID IT123456789, and the PO number. Please confirm the required invoice header fields.

Thanks,
Marco Bianchi
Sr. Procurement Manager
Aurora AI

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@auroraai.com>, Marco Bianchi <mbianchi@auroraai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Invoice recipient change + withholding tax question — Redwood redline attached

Hi Aurora team — thanks for the quick responses and for the tax certificate. Attaching a redlined order form (Aurora_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf) with our proposed language. Key commercial positions summarized below so they're easy to track:

1) Withholding tax options (pick one):
   a) Redwood invoices gross amount. Redwood bears withholding; Redwood adds an explicit gross-up uplift to the price. We propose a default uplift of up to 5% to cover potential withholding plus administrative costs (final % negotiable).
   b) Aurora withholds and remits taxes locally. Aurora provides official withholding receipts within 30 days of payment; Redwood accepts net payment.

2) Net terms / invoice cadence:
   - We can accept Net60 but need PO acceptance and signed order form before first invoice generation.
   - Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears unless parties agree to quarterly invoicing for large prepay schedules.

3) Currency and FX protection:
   - We will invoice in EUR. To protect against >3% monthly FX moves, we propose a mid-market monthly average adjustment clause to avoid material currency erosion.

4) Minimum commit / cure period:
   - Minimum annual commit is captured in Section 2. If a shortfall occurs, Redwood provides a 60-day cure period before clawback or invoice acceleration.

Items we've attached for your review: redline (Aurora_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf).

If Aurora prefers (a) above, please indicate the exact gross-up % you will accept; if (b), please confirm you will deliver withholding receipts for each tax remittance. Once we have direction, we'll prepare the final order form and DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — Kimberly Park
Finance & Commercial Counsel
Redwood Inference
attachments: Aurora_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@auroraai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Bianchi <mbianchi@auroraai.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 18:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: FW: Invoice recipient change + withholding tax question — Redwood redline attached

Kimberly — thank you for the clear summary and the redline. We've reviewed internally. A few confirmations from Aurora:

- We'll accept option (b) — Aurora will withhold as required under Italian law and will provide official withholding receipts for each payment.
- However, if Redwood prefers to issue grossed-up invoices instead of accepting net payment, Aurora can agree to a capped gross-up provided Redwood keeps the uplift under 2.5%.
- We confirm Net60 is required.
- We accept the 60-day cure period for minimum commits.

Please prepare the final order form with option (b) language (Aurora withholds) and a fallback line noting the capped gross-up (2.5%) if Redwood elects to gross-up instead. Also include the invoice header fields: Aurora S.r.l., Via Dante 12, Milan, VAT IT123456789, PO 6678. Tax certificate attached.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Director, Finance Operations
Aurora AI
attachments: tax_cert_Italy.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Final: Invoice routing, withholding, Net60 and next steps

Elena / Marco — great, thank you for the quick turn.

We confirm Redwood will accept Aurora withholding with the following attachments/steps to finalize:
- Redwood will keep option (b) as the primary path (Aurora withholds and provides receipts).
- Redwood accepts the alternate capped gross-up at 2.5% as a fallback if Redwood elects to gross-up for operational reasons.
- Net60 accepted. Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears; first invoice to be issued at month end (July 31) once order form is signed and PO #6678 is confirmed.
- Minimum commit cure period: 60 days agreed.
- Currency: invoices will be issued in EUR; invoice header will follow your spec.

I've created a DocuSign envelope for the final Order Form: https://docusign.net/somewhere/ABC123 (DocuSign_Aurora_OrderForm_link.txt attached). Please have your authorized signatory sign within 3 business days so we can start invoicing on schedule.

Attachments we are including in the envelope: Aurora_OrderForm_Redline_v3.pdf (finalized), PO_6678.pdf (as submitted), tax_cert_Italy.pdf (provided by Aurora).

Next steps for Aurora: confirm PO #6678 acceptance, sign DocuSign envelope, and share withholding receipts against each payment once remitted. Redwood will confirm invoice format (PDF with PO/fields) and send first invoice on July 31.

Appreciate the collaboration — Ben will follow up on any remaining billing metadata.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
